Crop rectangle <code>(135, 602, 1297, 2227)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>b311dd08703648a714da451e7d1e3f68b9af9861681b088ac117ae8be2f94a88</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
